title: Beacon Stairs Above Silence: Broken Witness
description: Beacon Stairs Above Silence unfolds across floating beacon stairways with glass bridges and radiant lock sigils, pushing a 5-Titan Empyrean squad to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, formationless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Beacon Stairs Above Silence: Broken Witness advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
terrain: floating beacon stairways with glass bridges and radiant lock sigils

objectives.primary: Defeat the chapter threat and preserve the faction doctrine under pressure.
optional: Keep at least four Titans standing
Trigger at least two Empyrean faction mechanics

enemyWaves.entry: emerge through angelic order pressure fractures
reinforcement from the Gate wound flank

boss.name: Oath-Eater in White Chains
boss.mechanic: changes faction hazard timing and objective pressure

specialRules: Choir Lock: beacon timing shields formation if objectives resolve in order.
Radiant Edict: structured actions reduce chaos effects and protect allies.
victoryConditions: Defeat the chapter threat and preserve the faction doctrine under pressure.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
